title: How Dependency-Graph Construction Changes Training Eligibility in Smart Contract Vulnerability Benchmarks: reproducibility package

creators.name: Kuznetsov, Oleksandr
creators.affiliation: eCampus University, Italy; V.N. Karazin Kharkiv National University, Ukraine

description: Code and derived evidence for the dependency-graph benchmark study. Includes frozen plans, graph memberships and canonical reconstructed lexical arrays, model scores and aggregate metrics, manuscript sources, and portable reproduction workflows. Upstream raw corpora and per-file annotations are excluded; scripts fetch pinned sources and verify checksums. Six original lexical edge arrays remain lost; new canonical reconstructions reproduce their recorded partitions but are not claimed to be original byte-identical edge lists. The evaluation is conditional on historical proxy-labelled populations and does not report real external detector validation. Authored code is MIT; author-created result tables and documentation are CC BY 4.0. See the included licence and public projection manifest.
